micromap.description: The index of the micromap in the root `micromaps` array.
micromap.gltf_detailedDescription: References the micromap build data used when attaching opacity micromaps to this primitive's triangles.

micromapIndices.description: The index of the accessor containing one micromap index per triangle.
micromapIndices.gltf_detailedDescription: The index of a `SCALAR` accessor with one element per triangle of the primitive. Each element is either a micromap triangle index or a special index (-1 to -4, stored as two's-complement bit patterns for unsigned component types). When undefined, triangle `t` uses micromap triangle `t + micromapBaseTriangle`.

micromapBaseTriangle.description: Offset added to non-special micromap indices before lookup.
micromapBaseTriangle.gltf_detailedDescription: Added to each non-special lookup value before indexing into the micromap triangles array. Defaults to 0.
